svg.title: claudia - E7.2 architecture 1: where the files, the loader and the help requests go
svg.desc: Class diagram: persona.md and skills.md in each app package, Guidance and Recipe with load_guidance in claudia_server, ModelParts and ModelEngine passing them to the Request, the lenses with the help requests, and Request and Agent in claudia_ai.
svg.text: E7.2 architecture 1 — the files live with the app; the server loads them for that app only
One loader, found by the package of the document's model class: no table of app names. The agent in claudia_ai only prints two more texts.
Placement: a recipe is written by
whoever knows the app, next to the
app's own help. Not in the server:
`Uses: a, b` line names the requests
no folder or file -> empty Guidance
The three lenses add help_search and help_topic to look_methods; one shared
show_help writes the answer (the product's own text: shown as text, not fenced).
text it is given and parses commands.
the engine decides what is offered.
bold coloured line = new or changed member of an existing class · «…» = kind · open triangle = is a
